_README: PLACEHOLDER DATA — DO NOT SHIP TO PRODUCTION AS-IS. These are NOT real people. Per PRD §4.2, the Kargil martyrs dataset is a content workstream that must be sourced and factually verified from OFFICIAL government records (Ministry of Defence gallantry-awards database, war-memorial records) before launch. Because these represent real, named, deceased individuals, accuracy is paramount and must NOT be filled in from an AI's general knowledge. Every record below has "is_placeholder": true so the UI can render a visible 'unverified placeholder' banner. Replace this entire file with the verified dataset. The `native_state` and `gallantry_award` values used here are generic taxonomy labels (real states / real award names) only so the directory's filters can be exercised — they make no factual claim about any individual.
